Tom — thanks for the clear summary. Below is a concise breakdown to help your infra and procurement run the numbers quickly. I attached a short PDF with pricing tiers and a CSV with microbenchmarks (small/medium/large models) for A100/H100/L40S.

High-level recommendations (short):
- If you need headroom for >70B fine-tuned models, prefer H100 (80GB variants) for reliability on large contexts. H100 gives best raw perf but at a higher cost.
- A100 (40/80GB) is a good balance for most 13B–70B workloads and tends to be strongest on perf/$ for batched throughput with larger context lengths.
- L40S is the most cost-efficient for quantized int8 workloads and lighter models (<=13B); good if you can quantize and accept minor quality delta.

Representative list pricing (Dedicated, per GPU-hour, before commit discounts):
- A100-80GB: $4.10/hr
- A100-40GB: $2.60/hr
- H100-80GB: $7.20/hr
- L40S-48GB: $1.95/hr

Typical commit discounts we offer (negotiable):
- 12-month commit: ~15% off list (standard)
- 24-month commit: ~25% off list
- Volume tier: additional 5–10% for >50-GPU equivalent commit

Performance/throughput (approx., aggregated per GPU for mixed model workload from our bench):
- A100-80GB: 700–1,200 tokens/sec (aggregate, depends on batch/opt) — best for long-context throughput
- H100-80GB: 1,200–2,000 tokens/sec — highest single-card throughput, better for low-latency single-streams
- L40S-48GB: 400–900 tokens/sec — best perf/$ for quantized models

SLOs and guarantees for Dedicated commits:
- Baseline: 99.5% availability with regional redundancy options
- Throughput guarantee: we size a pool to hit agreed sustained throughput (tokens/sec) with a 10% buffer; we can include an SLA credit if sustained throughput falls below target for two consecutive weeks after commissioning
- Burst: configurable burst pool (pay-as-you-go pricing) for short peaks

Sizing rule-of-thumb we use: expected tokens/sec = (daily_tokens / active_window_seconds) and then provision GPUs = ceil(tokens/sec / per_gpu_tokens_sec_eff). I attached the calculator in the PDF.

Pricing example for your baseline (ballpark):
- If you target an effective 1,200 tokens/sec sustained: 3 A100-80GB equivalent GPUs at list => $4.10 * 24 * 30 * 3 = $8,856/mo before discounts. With a 12-month 15% commit discount => ~$7,528/mo.

Options we can propose for procurement:
- 12-month commit (recommended to start): 12-month term + 10% upfront credit => standard 15% discount
- 24-month + prepay: 25% off + additional operational credits (migration + integration)

Next steps: if you want, we can propose a firm commercial with exact numbers for 12/24 months and a pilot PO for a 30-day proof-of-performance on a small dedicated pool.

Best,
Diego Fernández
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
